headline: Trump's party loses Congress in US midterms, lifting Indian markets, while NDA sweeps Andhra local polls and Telangana battles Cyclone Murasu floods.

stories.title: NDA sweeps Andhra Pradesh local body polls
stories.summary: NDA won the local body elections decisively, with analysts seeing no sign of anti-incumbency. TDP swept the Tirupati, Kadapa, Nellore and Ongole corporations, and YSRCP won just one ward each in Kadapa and Nellore.
stories.why_it_matters: A major signal on the state of AP politics, though alliance rifts remain to be sorted out.

stories.title: Telangana rescuers missing after boats capsize in Peddacheruvu
stories.summary: Two inflatable boats carrying 11 personnel capsized in the swollen rivulet while rescuing five stranded fishermen. Eight rescuers have been saved, and the search continues for three others.
stories.why_it_matters: A serious Telangana incident from the Cyclone Murasu rains.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu lashes Bhadradri, Telangana
stories.summary: Extremely heavy rains hit Bhadradri Kothagudem, with mandals such as Aswaropet and Dammapeta badly affected. In AP, ZPTC/MPTC elections in Agency mandals were postponed because of the rains.
stories.why_it_matters: Direct impact on Telangana and AP, including on the conduct of polls.

stories.title: SC refuses to move Tirupati ghee adulteration case out of AP
stories.summary: The Supreme Court declined to transfer the case. CBI and ED probes found a ₹250 crore scam involving 68 lakh kg of fake ghee supplied to TTD between 2019 and 2024.
stories.why_it_matters: A high-profile AP case will continue in the state.

stories.title: Centre weighs withdrawing safe harbour for Meta, Google, X
stories.summary: Per a report, the Centre is exploring removing safe harbour protection from platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and X. Separately, Delhi Police registered an FIR over alleged child abuse material links on Meta platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: It could change platform liability rules and affect Indian tech compliance and engineering.

stories.title: Supreme Court bars illegal detention, seeks affidavits
stories.summary: The court sought affidavits on Metro curbs and alleged violations of its October 9 order, with lawyers citing the Emergency.
stories.why_it_matters: A significant civil liberties matter before the top court.

stories.title: Cabinet clears ₹2,814 cr lithium and nickel processing scheme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a scheme to set up processing capacity for critical minerals. The aim is to cut import dependence.
stories.why_it_matters: Industrial policy for EV and battery supply chains.

stories.title: Democrats take Congress; Trump blames Iran war fallout
stories.summary: Democrats can now pass legislation, but Trump retains his veto. Vance bluntly blamed the Iran war for the defeat, Trump acknowledged the conflict's role, and Iran's chief negotiator said Americans voted 'no to war'.
stories.why_it_matters: It reshapes US policy on Iran, Ukraine, trade and tech, with global ripple effects.

stories.title: Ukraine says Russian double-tap strike killed at least 40
stories.summary: Kyiv says at least 40 people died in Monday's attack on a village and 30 may still be under rubble. Zelenskyy hopes the new Democratic Congress will bring more US help.
stories.why_it_matters: The war continues, and US politics may shift support.

stories.title: South Korea eyes wider anti-piracy patrols near Hormuz
stories.summary: Seoul proposes extending its Cheonghae unit's patrols toward waters near Oman's Duqm amid US pressure over the Iran war.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows the Gulf conflict pulling in more countries, with consequences for oil and shipping.

stories.title: Joshua Wong jailed for 10 years in Hong Kong
stories.summary: The 30-year-old pro-democracy activist is among hundreds detained under the national security law.
stories.why_it_matters: A landmark moment for Hong Kong's civil liberties.

stories.title: Paraguay's Ueno Bank shut over solvency crisis
stories.summary: The bank was closed overnight, and protests have erupted as depositors face losses.
stories.why_it_matters: A bank failure with a large share of the population's savings affected.

stories.title: Israel's president begins consultations after election deadlock
stories.summary: Herzog warned parties that not every promise can be kept if they want to avoid another election.
stories.why_it_matters: Political instability in Israel during a regional war.

stories.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño heats Pacific
stories.summary: Countries used to typhoons have seen unusually wild weather in recent months.
stories.why_it_matters: Climate-linked disasters continue to escalate.

stories.title: Indian financials lead rally after US midterms
stories.summary: Nifty Financial Services rose nearly 3% and Bank Nifty 2.2% as foreign investors returned and crude fell. Bond yields eased in India and overseas, and the rupee opened at a two-week high.
stories.why_it_matters: Explains the market move and the macro tailwinds, though analysts warn the rupee may weaken later.

stories.title: Weakest Samvat in 15 years as Samvat 2083 begins
stories.summary: Sensex and Nifty fell nearly 8% in the Samvat year. Analysts cite earnings growth and better valuations as supports but warn of persistent global uncertainty.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful context for a long-term index investor.

stories.title: Gold up 14-15% since last Dhanteras
stories.summary: Gold rose over 1% on Thursday ahead of Dhanteras on November 6. Prices have risen nearly 14-15% in a year.
stories.why_it_matters: Context for gold as an asset and for festive buying.

stories.title: GPF balance may not go to nominee, says Centre
stories.summary: The Centre's October 29 clarification explains Rule 33 on who gets a deceased employee's GPF balance.
stories.why_it_matters: A relevant rule for provident fund and family finances.

stories.title: Sitaram Denims files IPO papers with Sebi
stories.summary: The IPO combines a fresh issue and an offer for sale by promoters. Proceeds will go to debt repayment, working capital and a new garment facility in Bhilwara.
stories.why_it_matters: A pipeline filing, with no dates or price band yet.

stories.title: Data centers lost the midterms
stories.summary: Voters backed candidates favouring data center moratoriums and ballot measures, and 76% of Election Day voters polled by NBC held a view the item truncates. Texas, the fastest-growing US data center market, flipped to Democrats.
stories.why_it_matters: It threatens the AI infrastructure buildout that underpins AI job growth.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires Pierre to expand Codex
stories.summary: OpenAI is buying Pierre Computer Company, developer of open-source coding tools, to strengthen Codex in building and reviewing software. Meta also acquired Conductor, a startup for deploying teams of coding agents.
stories.why_it_matters: Big labs are consolidating AI coding-agent tooling.

stories.title: OpenAI is ready to IPO in 2027, Brockman says
stories.summary: Greg Brockman said most revenue now comes from enterprise sales.
stories.why_it_matters: The enterprise-heavy mix is where Forward Deployed Engineer demand sits.

stories.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights released
stories.summary: Moonshot AI published the model weights on Hugging Face. A separate open-weight model, Ripple-65B, is pitched as US state of the art for agentic coding.
stories.why_it_matters: Open models keep pushing capability for self-hosted agent work.

stories.title: Uber: only four rides booked via AI agents last quarter
stories.summary: Third-party AI agents arranged four rides in Q3, and about 500 Uber Eats orders.
stories.why_it_matters: A reality check on agentic commerce adoption.

stories.title: Apple cuts employee AI usage budgets
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Apple reduced budgets for internal AI use, including for engineering teams, as part of cost control.
stories.why_it_matters: A signal on AI tooling costs inside big tech.

stories.title: Google defaults AI off for schoolchildren after backlash
stories.summary: Google will switch off AI tools for students by default after criticism of pushing features onto schools.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows rising regulatory and political pressure on AI deployment.

stories.title: Inkitt builds one-shot PR creator with resumable agent orchestration
stories.summary: The event-driven orchestrator persists workflow state, runs short-lived agent containers, bounds retries and enforces permissions. Human review remains before merge.
stories.why_it_matters: A practical design pattern for production agent systems.

stories.title: Docker urges isolation and governance for AI agent security
stories.summary: Docker's guide lists five risks when agents browse, run code and call tools, arguing conventional app security is insufficient.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to building secure agent systems.

stories.title: Go gets a new JSON API
stories.summary: The Go team published a post on a new JSON API (jsonv2).
stories.why_it_matters: A notable standard library change for backend work.

stories.title: Binance hackers planned heist for months
stories.summary: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling and fake job interviews.
stories.why_it_matters: A useful case study in social engineering and supply-chain attacks, especially for fintech.

stories.title: I4C warns banks and fintechs of AI-led cyberattacks
stories.summary: India's cyber crime centre cautioned banks, NBFCs and fintech startups about growing AI-driven attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly relevant to fintech engineering.

stories.title: PhysicsWallah Q2 profit more than doubles
stories.summary: Net profit rose to ₹143.63 crore and revenue grew 18% to ₹1,242.26 crore, with shares up 10%. Other results: Shiprocket turned profitable and Amagi's profit rose nearly 30x.
stories.why_it_matters: Indian tech companies are turning profitable post-IPO.

stories.title: Google to invest $15 bn in Malaysia data centres
stories.summary: The investment runs over 2027-2028 and expands on a $2 billion plan from 2024.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows continuing AI infrastructure capex despite political pushback.

stories.title: Kohli and quicks give India 1-0 lead in Auckland
stories.summary: India's seamers were relentless against New Zealand, backed by excellent fielding and captaincy.
stories.why_it_matters: The Indian team's result in the current series.

stories.title: Afghanistan face Zimbabwe in Test with WTC spot on horizon
stories.summary: Antum Naqvi is set to debut for Zimbabwe, who are led by Brian Bennett in Ngarava's absence.
stories.why_it_matters: A WTC-relevant Test.
